prompt: Built-in imagegen: nine distinct crude prehistoric finds in a square 3x3 warm ivory paper and matte gouache swatch. Cells: wet clay sealing leak, pebble smoothing raw hide, reed blowing ochre, feather caught in split branch, seed-scooping bark curl, two finger-rest impressions in clay, sliding fiber loop, root paste cooling on flat stone, bough dragging hide bundle.

entries.review: Top-left: irregular wet clay pressed into a natural gap between rocks with water seeping beneath.
Top-middle: small smooth pebble resting on a visibly rubbed patch of raw hide.
Top-right: pigment-stained reed directed at an ochre cloud on rough rock, without writing or brush.
Middle-left: loose feather held upright in a naturally split branch, no quill or fitting.
Middle-middle: rough tree-bark curl holding a few loose wild seeds.
Middle-right: lumpy unfired clay with two coarse finger-rest hollows, no vessel walls.
Bottom-left: coarse fiber sliding loop around a rough branch, with a free pull tail.
Bottom-middle: irregular flat stone bearing a cooling smear of pale root paste.
Bottom-right: leafy bough carrying a rough hide bundle along scraped earth, no cart or runners.
